highlights: Update your joined servers to this version too, so that parallel tasks, workflow folders, typed workflow answers and up to 20 provider accounts work there.
Agents can split unrelated work into tasks that run at the same time and combine the results for you.
Open the agent browser in its own window and move it to a second monitor.
Word documents open in the file preview, and the Files panel opens the workspace folder of the agent.
Change any keyboard shortcut in the new Keyboard tab of Settings.
